budget.title: Full-Day Szentendre Mixed Budget Experience
budget.summary: A full-day blend of art, history, nature, and local budget-friendly food — perfect if you want a little bit of everything.

schedule.title: Fő Tér Morning Warm-Up
schedule.description: Start at the main square surrounded by colorful houses, early cafés, and charming Old Town energy.

schedule.title: Old Town Art & Architecture Walk
schedule.description: Explore small galleries, cobblestone streets, and historic buildings representing Szentendre’s artistic identity.

schedule.title: Church Visit
schedule.description: Visit one of the historic churches — Serbian, Catholic, or Greek Orthodox — each adding a different cultural layer.

schedule.title: Budget Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy affordable Hungarian dishes — soups, goulash, stews, or daily menus at friendly prices.

schedule.title: Danube Riverside Walk
schedule.description: Stroll along the riverside promenade for fresh air and peaceful scenery.

schedule.title: Marzipan Museum or Small Museum of Your Choice
schedule.description: Pick a fun museum for a light and entertaining visit — marzipan figures or quirky local exhibits.

schedule.title: Evening Break in a Simple Bar or Café
schedule.description: End with a budget-friendly drink — lemonade, beer, or coffee — in a relaxed Old Town spot.

comfortable.title: Full-Day Szentendre Mixed Comfort Tour
comfortable.summary: A comfortable full-day route combining nature, art, architecture, history, and a pleasant local lunch.

schedule.title: Riverside Coffee Start
schedule.description: Begin your day with coffee by the Danube — calm water, fresh air, and a peaceful mood.

schedule.title: Artistic Old Town Walk
schedule.description: Wander through galleries, artisan shops, and photogenic alleys in the historic center.

schedule.title: Historic Church Stop
schedule.description: Visit one of Szentendre’s iconic churches — known for their unique blend of cultural influences.

schedule.title: Comfortable Local Lunch
schedule.description: Enjoy a relaxed sit-down meal featuring Hungarian classics in a cozy restaurant.

schedule.title: Green Walk Along the Creek
schedule.description: Take a refreshing walk along Bükkös Creek — a small nature escape inside the town.

schedule.title: Art Mill Visit
schedule.description: Explore contemporary art exhibitions in the industrial-style Művész Malom building.

schedule.title: Evening Wine or Cocktail
schedule.description: End the day at a pleasant bar or wine spot with a relaxed atmosphere.
